name: manual_18f5ca
claim: When git commit output is piped through '| tail -N', a commit failure can look like success because the error message is truncated. Always check 'git status --short' after a commit that used tail-truncated output to confirm the file is no longer staged.

decisions.notes: 2026-06-28: 'git add ... && git commit ... 2>&1 | tail -3' showed 'Everything up-to-date' (the push message) while the file was still staged — the commit had failed due to LINT-006 but the error was cut off. Only discovered on second attempt with full output.
